instruction: Review the committed change benchmark-base..HEAD without modifying or staging files. ledger.allocate(amount, count) splits a nonnegative decimal currency string with exactly two fractional digits into count positive-numbered slots (count 1..10). Return count two-decimal strings summing exactly to amount. Shares differ by at most one cent; when cents cannot divide evenly, earlier slots get the extra cents. Inputs are valid and amounts are <=999.99. Report only actionable defects introduced by the candidate; do not report style preferences.
